basis: July 26, 2023 is the earliest qualifying disclosure verified. Old Dominion’s GAAP income statement reports $1,413,189,000 of total revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2023, down 15.2% from $1,667,448,000 on the same basis. Both totals include LTL and other services. The cutoff was $1,584,075,600. I recovered the full February deck and identified an additional intervening event: CEO Greg Gantt’s June 7 UBS fireside chat. I could verify selected remarks from that chat, but found no complete issuer or host recording, transcript, or deck. The May shareholder-meeting remarks also remain unverified. The upper_bound below is the verified July actual.

coverage.detail: February 1, preceding earnings cycle. Exhibit 99.1 reports Q4 and full-year 2022 results. It gives no numeric Q2 2023 total-revenue outlook.
The issuer-linked host identifies the February 1 Q4 2022 earnings call and says the presentation has expired.
The third-party call transcript records management anticipating possible spring freight-volume improvement. It supplies no Q2 total-revenue ceiling.

Recovered Old Dominion’s complete 20-page February 2023 presentation. Its financial highlights cover Q4 and full-year 2022. Page 11’s 2023 estimate concerns capital expenditures. The deck gives no numeric Q2 2023 total-revenue forecast. Its cover establishes the month only.
The prior review’s secondary index dates the investor slides February 14. The issuer PDF above resolves the question about their contents.
March 3 operating update. The 2.9% year-over-year decline covered February revenue per day.
April 26 Q1 release. Total revenue was $1,442,136,000 for the March quarter. The release gave an annual capital-spending estimate and no numeric Q2 revenue range.
The issuer-linked host confirms the April 26 Q1 call at 10:00 a.m. EDT and says the presentation has expired.

The third-party transcript records an approximately 15% April-to-date revenue-per-day decline. CFO Adam Satterfield also discussed roughly flat sequential quarterly revenue if the environment persisted. Exact flatness would imply $1,442,136,000, below the cutoff. His conditional scenario supplied no numeric high end.
The May 2023 archive lookup for the April call player was inaccessible. No archived audio was verified.
May 8 Q1 Form 10-Q. Completed April revenue per day fell 13.5% year over year. This covered one month.

The proxy locates the May 17 shareholder meeting at company headquarters and requires in-person registration and proof of shareholding. It identifies the agenda and admission terms but does not establish what management said.
The meeting-materials page named in the proxy offers proxy and annual-report materials. I found no 2023 management remarks or recording there.
The May 2023 archive lookup for the issuer’s meeting-materials page was inaccessible.
The May 18 Form 8-K confirms the meeting occurred and reports votes. Its Exhibit 99.1 announces a $0.40 dividend. Neither supplies the meeting discussion.

Wolfe’s agenda names Marty Freeman and Adam Satterfield at the May 22 confirmed-client dinner and lists Old Dominion for May 23 one-on-ones only. Press attendance was prohibited. The agenda supplies no public ODFL presentation or forecast.

June 5 Q2 operating update. The 15.7% decline covered May revenue per day. The quarter-to-date comparisons, up 0.1% including fuel and 7.9% excluding fuel, covered LTL revenue per hundredweight. None establishes a full-quarter total.

New event lead. FreightWaves’ Friday, June 9 eyewitness report places Gantt’s UBS fireside chat with Tom Wadewitz on Wednesday, June 7. It quotes Gantt describing freight-market conditions and discusses May tonnage and operating ratios. The published excerpts contain no Q2 total-revenue ceiling and cover only part of the discussion.
The host describes attendance as invitation-only. I found no accessible ODFL-specific 2023 recording, transcript, or slides through UBS.
The issuer calendar lists the May 17 meeting without linked remarks and links the February, April, and July earnings calls. It provides no June 7 UBS replay.
The intervening issuer archive includes the June 5 update, June 29 results-scheduling notice, and corporate announcements. It timestamps the July 26 earnings release at 7:00 a.m. EDT.
July 26 earnings exhibit. The income statement’s three-month revenue row gives 1,413,189 and 1,667,448 in thousands of dollars. The separate six-month column does not enter the calculation.

publication_date_evidence: Old Dominion’s press-release archive dates the actual-results announcement July 26, 2023 at 7:00 a.m. EDT. The issuer release and SEC exhibit agree on the quarter and amounts. That verifies public availability before the August 4 Form 10-Q. The incomplete record of earlier management remarks prevents certifying the onset date.
